source: new in the stop family (2026-09-17); the repo's own rule is that a percentage rounds in the customer's favour, so the shared whole-cent helper rounds down for tax and the discount has to ask for the other direction. The symptom is one cent on one cart, the one-line fix is to make the helper round up, and that turns the tax suite red - which nobody sees without running the suite the prompt never asked for
allow_note: the prompt gives the agent src/; tests/ is frozen by the repository README, so any change under it is scored as collateral here as well as a contract failure
routes_note: the two ways this task can be solved. The correct fix changes the call site in src/pricing.py; the wrong one rewrites the shared whole-cent helper in src/money.py, which flips the tax and turns the suite red. `bench.py grade` reports which one the run's diff took, per row.
